dogecoin.text:
@StoningStephenX @dogecoin_empire I'm finished with the discourse about woman's entitlement to a man's priorities and value hierarchies. We were all here when the near totality of women were cheering on this foolishness about competing against us in the marketplace instead of joining us in family.

FALL.

@dogecoin_empire It can't. We've gone cold, your value propositions are laughably bad and the world as we see it today, is one such we can't wait to leave behind, after we're done what it is we've set out to do. 

It is your place to wither in the regret that none of those deeds were about you.
